resources.string: Blank: conservative 32,000 input budget, not a model capability. Includes system, tools and history. Output is separate; applies next task.
Blank: 4,000 tokens. This task target is separate from model capabilities. Summary output has its own 2,000-token target.

Optional per-model capability overrides. Blank uses catalog metadata when available; otherwise capability stays unknown. A known shared window constrains input + output. Both output targets are capped by model limits.
Saved effective budgets: input %1$d · main output %2$d · summary output %3$d tokens
OFF requests disabled reasoning where supported. Unknown providers may keep their own default; omission alone does not guarantee reasoning is disabled.
